articles.summary: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) (NYSE: MSGE ) announced today that Josephine Vaccarello has been named President of MSG Entertainment. In this elevated role, Ms. Vaccarello, who most recently served as the Company’s Executive Vice President, Live, will oversee the strategy and operations of multiple areas of the business as MSG Entertainment continues to focus on enhancing and expanding its portfolio of live experiences for the millions of guests welcomed to the Company’s venues at hundreds of events each year. Ms. Vaccarello’s purview now includes oversight of the Company’s entertainment and sports bookings across concerts, family shows, comedy, performing arts, special events, and all non-New York Knicks and New York Rangers sports bookings, as well as the productions business, which includes the Radio City Rockettes and the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes . articles.title: Josephine Vaccarello Named President of MSG Entertainment

articles.summary: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE: MSGE ) (the “Company” or “MSG Entertainment”) today announced that the Company repurchased 314,349 shares of MSGE Class A common stock at an average price of $79.53 per share for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $25 million from September 11, 2026 through September 17, 2026. The share repurchases were funded using cash on hand. Since the Company was spun off from Sphere Entertainment Co. in April 2023, the Company has repurchased 6,420,588 shares of MSGE Class A common stock for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $230 million. About Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences.
